author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete

GO:0007263 nitric oxide mediated signal transduction -> GO:0038060 nitric oxide-cGMP-mediated signaling
GO:0010749 regulation of nitric oxide mediated signal transduction -> GO:0141149 regulation of nitric oxide-cGMP mediated signal transduction
GO:0010751 negative regulation of nitric oxide mediated signal transduction ->  GO:0141151 negative regulation of nitric oxide-cGMP mediated signal transduction
GO:0010750 positive regulation of nitric oxide mediated signal transduction -> GO:0141150 positive regulation of nitric oxide-cGMP mediated signal transduction

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/26613

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1b69VGCfkRCBFZzMf7EyUZFtRIJxvNmspc-3IS-wDRRQ/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
MGI	15 DONE
~PINC	4~
RGD	2 DONE
TAIR	2 DONE
~UniProt	5~
ZFIN	4
BHF-UCL	1 -  done

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
None.



Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0007263 nitric oxide mediated signal transduction & regulation children

author: LiNiMGI
body: @pgaudet @raymond91125 Almost all the MGI annotations on the list are NOT cGMP-dependent, if we obsolete the GO:0007263 nitric oxide mediated signal transduction, will we create any new term for the cGMP-independent signaling pathway? thanks!

author: raymond91125
body: @LiNiMGI and other curators, are there problems removing these annotations still? I can try to help.

author: mlkaldunski
body: @raymond91125 I've removed the RGD annotations, but I haven't seen any resolution to the need for a "nitric oxide mediated signal transduction" term that does not specify cGMP dependency.

author: raymond91125
body: @mlkaldunski Thanks for the note. @pgaudet pointed out that we don't want to create a "cGMP-independent" term. My suggestion is to move annotations, e.g. for Rasd1, to GO:0071732 cellular response to nitric oxide and perhaps fill in the details in a GO-CAM model. Would that work? Thanks.

author: mlkaldunski
body:
Thanks for the note. Yes, I understand @pgaudet's point about not having "-independent" terms.
I did in fact move the RGD annotations to "cellular response to nitric oxide"!
I don't do GO-CAM curation, but I will mention it to Dr. Wang.

author: LiNiMGI
body:
Thanks @raymond91125, Pascale helped me :)
MGI done.
